sections.text: Arzthelferin: Kinderarztpraxis, guten Morgen. :: Paediatric practice, good morning. ich: Guten Morgen. Mein Sohn ist krank. Ich brauche heute einen Termin. :: Good morning. My son is ill. I need an appointment today. Arzthelferin: Was hat er denn? :: What's wrong with him? ich: Er hat seit gestern Fieber und Husten. :: He has had a fever and a cough since yesterday. Arzthelferin: Wie hoch ist das Fieber? :: How high is the fever? ich: Heute Morgen hatte er 39 Grad. :: This morning he had 39 degrees. Arzthelferin: Kommen Sie bitte um elf Uhr. Bringen Sie die Versichertenkarte mit. :: Please come at eleven o'clock. Bring the health insurance card. ich: Gut, um elf Uhr. Vielen Dank! :: Good, at eleven o'clock. Thank you very much!

sections.heading: Variations
sections.text: 7 Arzthelferin: Heute ist leider alles voll. Kommen Sie morgen um acht in die offene Sprechstunde. :: Sadly everything is full today. Come to the open consultation tomorrow at eight.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: A model conversation: written to practise, not one that happened. Versichertenkarte (also Gesundheitskarte ): the card of the health insurance. Bring it every quarter, and the U-Heft for check-ups.
